signals_info.description: Distance to the relevant front obstacle.

nl_Literal_translation_en: From 1 to 3 seconds from now, the distance to the front obstacle shall remain greater than 10 meters.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从现在起第 1 秒到第 3 秒之间，与前方障碍物的距离应始终大于 10 米。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the AEB monitoring window beginning at 1 second and ending at 3 seconds, the vehicle shall continuously maintain more than 10 meters of front-obstacle clearance.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在从第 1 秒开始至第 3 秒结束的 AEB 监测窗口内，车辆与前方障碍物应持续保持大于 10 米的距离。
